minor.issue: invalid_language error message still says 'Pick English, French, Portuguese or Arabic.' — Spanish missing (numbers.js:390).
relocalizeIvr only swaps greetings; built-in English option labels (e.g. 'Sales') stay English after a language switch. This only matters if labels are ever spoken or shown to callers.

ui_bugs.issue: If the user switches the app language while the IVR tab is open, the greeting textarea keeps the old-language text. Local state is set once from num.features.ivr; the number is not reloaded after PUT /prefs/lang. Example: EN → FR without reload still shows 'Thank you for calling…'. Clicking Save IVR then sends the English greeting with language 'fr' and overwrites the French greeting the server just localized. Fix: reload the number (or re-init g/list) when lang changes, or translate default greetings client-side on lang change.

On the first open, the panel briefly shows the 'needs an active number on the Pro plan or higher' empty state while /numbers is loading (seen once for Alice on Business; fine on the second run). Add a loading state instead of the empty state while nums is null.

issues: Labels are 11px (target ≥12px); FR/ES labels fit without overflow (Accueil/Numéros/Acheter/Portefeuille/Plus, Resumen/Números/Comprar/Billetera/Más).
'Voicemail on' toggle row sits directly against the 'Greeting' label with no vertical gap; the 'Greeting language' label also sits tight under the greeting select.

action_items: IvrTab: re-sync greeting/options state when the app language changes (reload the number after PUT /prefs/lang), so Save does not overwrite the server-localized greeting with stale-language text
numbers.js:390 — add Spanish to the invalid_language message
Softphone: show a loading state instead of the 'needs Pro' empty state while /numbers loads
Minor spacing polish: Voicemail tab toggle/label gaps, Settings voice speed select vs Save button gap; consider 12px bottom-nav labels
critical_code_review_comments: support.js visitor rate limit is per IP (all visitors behind one NAT/office share 10/hour) — acceptable but worth documenting; the limit is checked before the AI call, so no credits are spent on 429.
Shell.js sends PUT /prefs/lang on every Shell mount (several times per session); the server short-circuits when lang is unchanged (updated:0), so the only cost is redundant requests.
The welcome channel card is dismissed via localStorage 'civr.channelCard', which is per browser, not per account: a dismissal on a shared browser hides it for other new accounts too.
The console shows React 'span cannot be a child of tr/tbody' hydration warnings, caused by the platform visual-edit wrapper spans (data-ve-dynamic) around LogTable rows, not app code.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; 1 medium stale-state bug in IvrTab after a live language switch)
